description: This file contains service functions for managing and filtering candidate, client, position, and interview data, as well as processing Excel uploads for bulk data upsert in a recruitment metrics dashboard backend.

methods.name: paginate(query, page: int, page_size: int)

methods.name: apply_candidate_filters(query, args: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Applies filters to a candidate query based on provided filtering arguments.

methods.name: apply_interview_filters(query, args: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Applies filters to an interview query based on provided filtering arguments.

methods.name: apply_client_filters(query, args: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Applies filters to a client query based on provided filtering arguments.

methods.name: Tuple[int,int,list] process_excel_upload(file: FileStorage)
methods.description: Parses an uploaded Excel file and performs bulk upsert of clients, positions, and candidates.
